_README: Expected KE groupings — regression/monitoring fixture for collect_similar_events.py.
Each entry in 'expectations' asserts that a set of Key Event IDs must land in the
SAME group in the pipeline output. Use this to catch regressions when prompts,
batch sizes, or the model change and a pairing you rely on silently breaks apart.
label         (required) short human-readable name, shown in test output.
event_ids     (required) 2+ KE ID strings that must share one group.
expected_type (optional) one of: merge | soda | same_object_different_process
When set, the shared group must also be of this type.
Omit it to check co-grouping only (any type).
note          (optional) why you expect this pairing; not checked.
The test checks the newest ke_similar_events_*_pass3.json (falling back to _pass2)
under outputs/ke_groupings and outputs_for_vc/ke_groupings. Override with the
KE_GROUPINGS_FILE environment variable to point at a specific run.
Add your own pairings below. IDs are stable AOP-Wiki Event IDs.

expectations.label: PXR activation synonyms
expectations.note: Pregnane-X receptor / PXR / SXR / NR1I2 — same receptor, same direction.

expectations.label: Hepatocellular carcinoma synonyms
expectations.note: Promotion vs tumorigenesis of hepatocellular carcinoma. Excludes KE 1395 'Liver Cancer', which is the broader category (HCC is one type of liver cancer), not a synonym.

expectations.label: NMDAR directional opposites
expectations.note: Inhibition vs overactivation of NMDA receptors — strictly opposite directions.

expectations.label: Complex I binding vs inhibition
expectations.note: Binding of inhibitor vs inhibition of the same Complex I — review needed, not a merge.

expectations.label: Aromatase general vs granulosa-specific
expectations.note: Aromatase inhibition general vs specified in ovarian granulosa cells.
